findings.title: Missing technical specifications for site facilities
findings.message: The long text only lists "Bauzaun, Baustromverteiler, Bauwasseranschluss, Container und Verkehrssicherung nach RSA 21" without specifying dimensions, material classes, performance criteria or the meaning of RSA 21, which is not a recognized VOB/STLB standard. This violates VOB/A § 7 Abs. 1 (clear and exhaustive description) and lacks mandatory technical data (e.g., fence height, load class, water pressure).
findings.suggestion: Add detailed specifications: e.g., Bauzaun Höhe 2.5 m, Maschenweite 100 mm, Tragfähigkeit Klasse 3; Baustromverteiler 400 A, Schutzklasse IP44; Bauwasseranschluss DN 100, Druck 4 bar; Container Größe 20 ft, Typ ISO‑C; define RSA 21 or replace with standard reference.

findings.title: Vague execution instructions for utility trenches
findings.message: The phrase "vorsichtig öffnen, Leitungen sichern und wieder verfüllen" is not quantifiable and does not define the method, protection measures or tolerances required, which may lead to disputes under VOB/A § 7 Abs. 1.
findings.suggestion: Specify the excavation method (e.g., hand‑shovel with minimum 30 mm clearance), protection type (e.g., PVC‑Schutzrohr Ø 50 mm), backfill material and compaction level (e.g., 95 % Proctor).

findings.title: Unclear thickness and storage description
findings.message: The term "ca. 30 cm dick" and "seitlich mieten" are imprecise. Exact thickness, soil class and storage method must be defined according to STLB‑Bau standards.
findings.suggestion: State exact removal depth (e.g., 300 mm), soil type (e.g., Humus‑schicht, Klasse H1) and storage method (e.g., lateral stockpile on geotextile‑covered area, max 2 m height).

findings.title: Missing norm reference for trench backfill
findings.message: "Grabenverbau als Normverbau" does not specify which norm (e.g., DIN 4220, VOB/C ATV 311) and lacks details on material class, dimensions and installation tolerances.
findings.suggestion: Define the backfill as "Beton‑Verbau nach DIN 4220‑1, Druckfestigkeit C20/25, Mindestabstand 150 mm, Einbau bis 2,50 m Tiefe".

findings.title: Undefined term "Lasergefälle"
findings.message: The long text mentions "Steckmuffe L im Lasergefälle verlegen" – "Lasergefälle" is not a recognized technical term, making the requirement ambiguous and potentially unfulfillable.
findings.suggestion: Replace with a clear description, e.g., "Steckmuffe L aus Edelstahl, Lasergeschnitten, nach DIN 11851 verlegen".

findings.title: Missing reinforcement details for floor slab
findings.message: The slab description only states concrete class C30/37 XC4 and thickness. Reinforcement type, spacing and placement are not specified, which are required for a complete STLB‑Bau description.
findings.suggestion: Add reinforcement data, e.g., "Bewehrung: B500B Matten 150 mm x 150 mm, 200 mm Abstand, plus Stabstahl Ø 12 mm in Spannlage".

findings.title: Exclusion of all additional claims in the contract documents
findings.message: The preliminary note in 03_pdf_druck_risiken.txt states "Nachforderungen sind ausgeschlossen; das gesamte Baugrundrisiko trägt der Auftragnehmer" which shifts all risk to the contractor and may be ineffective under § 307 BGB (unreasonable disadvantage).
findings.suggestion: Introduce a balanced risk allocation clause, e.g., allow reasonable change orders for unforeseen ground conditions and define a maximum liability for the contractor.
